$comment: THE CURATED LIST — the single source of truth for which apps Focus Nudge can guard on Android, read by BOTH plugins/withFocusNudgeAndroid.js (which turns it into the manifest's <queries> allow-list) and src/lib/focus-nudge.ts (which renders the picker). One file so the two can never disagree: an app offered in the picker but missing from <queries> is invisible to the package manager, so it would show as 'not installed' forever with no error anywhere. WHY CURATED AND NOT 'PICK ANY APP': enumerating every installed app needs QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES, which is its OWN sensitive-permission declaration on top of the AccessibilityService one (PLAY_ACCESSIBILITY_DECLARATION.md) — two extended reviews instead of one. Checking a fixed allow-list of ~14 named packages needs only <queries> and no declaration at all. Full 'pick any app' is a v2 upgrade, deliberately not taken here. NOT IN THIS LIST, on purpose: browsers, messaging apps, and phone/maps/banking. A guard on a browser or on WhatsApp catches far more genuine need than drift, and this feature must never be the reason someone could not answer a message.
